name: mermaid-gui-dev
description: Dev-only test harness for the Mermaid GUI. The deployed site is static and build-step-free; nothing here runs at deploy time.

scripts.test:live: npm run fixtures && env MMD_LIVE=1 MMD_APP=live playwright test tests/live-app.spec.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:browser
